title: Speed from distance and time
prompt: Something moved distance pixels during a frame that lasted delta seconds. Return its speed in pixels per second.
signature: func solve(distance: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(distance: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return distance * delta
hint: The opposite of the first problem in this topic.
solution:
func solve(distance: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return distance / delta
